feature: Floating core: the floor stays, the platform goes
summary: ai-engineering becomes a safety floor under the agent the person already uses: it works in the current checkout or a worktree, detects the base branch instead of assuming main, keeps one checkpoint state with one TypeScript validator and guard, and drops the workspace hub, dead code and platform verbs while the orchestrator ceremony stays intact.
plain_summary: People can work where they already are, on any branch, open requests against the right branch, and never get stuck on unrelated files.
gating: Work checkpoints in order. Within a checkpoint, the gates run in order: behavior, then ui, then review. A checkpoint is "passed" only when every gate is "passed" or "n/a". Do not start checkpoint N+1 until checkpoint N has passed.
